evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Since even strong teachers can fail, we ask \emph{what remains learnable from imperfect teacher supervision?} Teacher failure is only a coarse problem-level signal and does not imply that all supervision along the associated student trajectory is unhelpful.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across mathematical reasoning and code generation, our method improves an offline OPD baseline by up to 2.7 percentage points and matches or outperforms online OPD variants on multiple benchmarks.
